worldcombat.skill.poisonjab.summary: Plant yourself and drive a venomous limb down a straight line in the aimed direction: a heavy physical strike that may leave poison in the wound and shoves it back a little. You can aim it at any direction, block or target, and the first body on the line (including an ally) takes the block. Deep Thrust hits harder but must get closer and winds up slower.
Plant yourself and drive a venomous limb out along a straight line, dealing about %1$s physical damage (scales with Attack); reach is %2$s, it strikes only the first body on the line, a front body shields the back, a wall stops it, and a whiff deals no damage.
On a hit, there is a %1$s chance to leave poison in the wound for %2$s (losing health over time) and to shove the target %3$s back along the thrust; Poison and Steel types are not poisoned.
Windup %1$s, recovery %2$s, cooldown %3$s; a whiff deals no damage or poison but still spends PP and goes on cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.poisonjab.deep.on: Deep Thrust: power x1.12, poison chance x1.12, shove x1.15, but reach x0.92, +2 windup and recovery x1.2.
worldcombat.skill.poisonjab.deep.off: Quick thrust (default): a faster windup and recovery and a longer reach, but lower power, poison chance and shove.
worldcombat.skill.poisonjab.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.poisonjab.growth.0: From level %1$s the deep-thrust power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.poisonjab.growth.1: From level %1$s the deep-thrust power is %2$s and poison lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.poisonjab.use.0: A lengthened heavy jab at close range
worldcombat.skill.poisonjab.use.1: Poison whatever closes in and shove it back
worldcombat.skill.poisonjab.use.2: Press a foe before it can act
worldcombat.skill.poisonjab.preference.d: On: power x1.12, poison chance x1.12, shove x1.15, but reach x0.92, +2 windup and recovery x1.2 - for close brawls. Off (quick thrust): a faster windup and recovery and a longer reach, but every jab is lighter.
worldcombat.skill.poisonjab.preference.a: Only within this distance does it consider the target for a thrust, then shared approach logic brings the body into reach; a larger value starts the chase sooner.

When on, unpoisoned targets rank higher so this heavy thrust spreads the poison; a target already poisoned only ranks lower and is still hit as a plain physical blow. When off, poison status does not affect ranking.
When on, the companion may leave its post to land a thrust; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
world_combat.move.poisonjab.text.immune: The foe shrugged off the poison
